answers.ameron_tulsa: Two Ameron Pole Products sites in Tulsa, both Arcosa-parented TRI reporters through reporting year 2024 and not marked closed: (1) 2333 S Yukon Ave, 74107, EPA name 'NOV AMERON TULSA POLE PRODUCTS WELDING & FABRICATION' (NAICS 332996), the Ameron fabricator address on DOT lists (GDOT QPL gives 2333 South Yukon Avenue; FDOT prints '233 S. Yukon Ave'; TxDOT gives the city only) and the pre-2011 Tulsa pole plant ('The company already has a plant in Tulsa at 2333 South Yukon.' News On 6, 2011-01-21); (2) 4903 E 66th St N, 74117 (TRI spelling '4903 N 66TH ST E'), EPA name 'NOV AMERON TULSA POLE PRODUCTS TUBE MANUFACTURING' (NAICS 331210). News On 6 says the 2011 $35M plant 'would be the second plant in Tulsa and will be located on 25 acres in the Cherokee Industrial Park, just south of the Whirlpool plant'; the 66th St site geocodes about 1 km due south of Whirlpool (7301 Whirlpool Dr), so it is inferred to be that plant (no source gives the Cherokee street address). The 2011 'will produce steel poles' quote therefore belongs to the 66th St plant, not Yukon. No source states which site makes steel poles today: Yukon is stated as welding & fabrication and is the DOT-listed steel pole fabricator; 66th St is stated as pole tube manufacturing. Sources: https://frs-public.epa.gov/ords/frs_public2/fii_query_dtl.disp_program_facility?p_registry_id=110055499278 , https://frs-public.epa.gov/ords/frs_public2/fii_query_dtl.disp_program_facility?p_registry_id=110064455879 , https://www.newson6.com/story/5e3665182f69d76f620775e5/california-company-to-build-new-plant-in-tulsa
answers.pacific_partner: The partner is H.W. Metal Products, Inc. (HW Metals), 19480 SW 118th Ave, Tualatin, OR 97062. Pacific Steel's own equipment-list PDF states 'HW Metals, Inc is Pacific Steel Structures manufacturing partner. We have a long term agreement in place to provide fabrication for us on all tapered tubular structures.' (https://www.pacificsteelstructures.com/wp-content/uploads/HW-Metals-Equipment-List.pdf), and HW's site confirms from its side: 'H.W. Metals, working in conjunction with our sales and engineering partner Pacific Steel Structures, is a full-service turnkey manufacturer of tapered and fabricated custom steel towers and tubing.' (https://www.hwmetals.com/tapered-tubular-steel). HW states MIG, submerged arc and open arc gantry welding, D1.1-certified welders, and towers up to 138 in x 138 in x 70 ft / 11 ft diameter. Size mismatch: Pacific Steel says 140,000 sq ft; HW's site and the PDF say 120,000 sq ft under roof on 14 acres.
